# Textarea

A multi-line text field with the same look as Input.

```tsx
import { Textarea } from '@kafka-ds/react'
```

## When to use it

- For answers longer than a sentence.

## When not to

- For a short value: use Input.

## Examples

### Multi-line

Resizable vertically. Use it for answers longer than a sentence.

```tsx
<div className="max-w-md">
  <Field label="Cuéntanos por qué quieres participar" hint="Una o dos frases bastan.">
    <Textarea />
  </Field>
</div>
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ref` | `Ref<HTMLTextAreaElement>` |  |  |
| `invalid` | `boolean` |  |  |
| …rest | `TextareaHTMLAttributes<HTMLTextAreaElement>` | | Everything else is passed to the underlying element. |

## Accessibility

- Same size, border, focus and invalid behaviour as Input.
- The reader can resize it vertically; it never resizes beyond its container.

## Content

- Say how long an answer is expected to be in the hint.
